experiment: Training-only 1%-99% feature winsorization plus causal market-state diagnostics
scope: Authorized research-only continuation. All261Friday observations have been inspected in earlier rounds. Design selected after round16 findings; per-fold causality is not an independent holdout. No new data, live actions, trading-profitability test, neural training or claim of full paper replication.
data: Unchanged CSI300 OHLCV and round5observation/label masks. All training joint_completed<=cutoff. Friday signals in the following calendar year with joint_completed<=2020-12-31. Target raw executable weekly return>0. Same samples, label maturity and training-frequency references for both feature families. Earlier held-out rows may enter later training only after completion. Retain invalid-OHLC exclusions, including the incomplete2015coverage; no forward-fill or new sample screening.
features: Reuse all24 hash-verified round16 training and validation feature caches:18 frozen MSE20 decoded representations plus6 deterministic raw25 representations. Same25 coordinates and sources. Retain unmodified native and two probe references exactly. No new representation or target.

clipping.description: Each coordinate uses its own annual training 1st/99th percentile. Clip training features; compute training mean and population SD after clipping; use those same bounds and moments on future features. Refit all24 logistic heads with the unchanged objective. No percentile/regularization/threshold grid and no probability clipping for prediction.

standardization.description: Each head uses its own training-column means and population SDs only. Apply frozen statistics to future rows. No normalization across folds, seed averaging before feature fitting, or rotations.

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

independent_solver.purpose: Verify all24heads with an independent objective/gradient; never use alternate coefficients for forecasts.

market_states.purpose: Diagnostic labels only; states do not enter any classifier, calibration, weighting, threshold, date screening or model switching this round.

descriptors.trend60: log(C_t/C_(t-60)) divided by max(populationSD of60 close log returns,1e-8)*sqrt(60)
descriptors.volatility20: Population SD of last20 daily close log returns
descriptors.range20: Mean of log(H_s/L_s) over last20 sessions, including signal date

market_states.thresholds: Fit separately at each cutoff using exactly its matured-label training input rows, without reading the label values: trend terciles 1/3 and2/3; volatility/range/volume medians. Freeze thresholds through the next calendar year. Use <= for the lower cell at a boundary. Annual labels are relative to that fold training distribution, not universal bull/bear labels.
market_states.primary_partition: Six cells: low/mid/high trend score crossed with low/high20-session volatility.
market_states.secondary_partitions: Volatility, range and volume-change binary partitions separately. No high-dimensional cross-product, hidden-state smoothing, clustering search or forward-return state definitions.
market_states.sparse: Always report every prespecified cell and its count. Cells with n<20 are marked sparse and are not grounds for selecting an expert. One-class cells have undefined balanced accuracy and AUROC. No subgroup significance tests or state-selected aggregate.

budget: 24 new deterministic Newton fits:18 learned_clip and6 raw25_clip. Complete all24 before any new held-out score. Reuse18 neural states with zero neural training steps.1044new seed/head probability forecasts;1827retained model forecasts;2871model rows and1827ensemble rows=7methods*261dates. Three probabilities averaged for learned_clip; raw25_clip is one head per fold, seed=-1 is a deterministic identifier. Independent solution replay is verification, not another candidate.
forecasts: Strict probability>0.5; average probabilities across inherited learned seeds. Native MSE retains its average-return sign and has no probability metrics. No state-conditioned model fitted this round.
metrics: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, AUROC, confusion counts, predicted-up fraction; Brier/log loss/probability moments only for probability methods. Clip log-loss probabilities to[1e-12,1-1e-12] for reporting only and record clip counts. Report bothwindows,all6years,all3learned/native seeds and pooled descriptive results. Training scores remain supervised in-sample diagnostics. Five fixed reliability bins per probability method per window, including empty bins.
pooled: 261weeks pooled only for descriptive metrics. All comparisons and state analyses use separate120-week early and141-week late windows. Report six years and learned/native seed results.
inference: 12prespecified contrasts=6in each window, candidate-minus-reference losses,negativebetter. Circular8retained-observation blocks,10000replicates,seed20260910 separately for each window; centered two-sided p and Holm across all12. Blocks refer to retained observations, not necessarily8calendar weeks, because exclusions create gaps. Percentile95% intervals descriptive; no coverage claim for fitting, retrospective selection or repeated research. No pooled primary tests.
descriptive_screen: Eight strict flags per candidate per window: accuracy beats its unmodified probe, nativeMSE and trainingfrequency; Brier beats its unmodified probe and trainingfrequency; logloss beats trainingfrequency; at least2/3years beat native accuracy; at least2/3years beat frequency Brier. All8 in bothwindows required for a cross-period descriptive pass. Ties fail. No automatic promotion; all dates previously examined.
shift_diagnostics: Per-head training and validation coordinate clipping fractions, validation row clipping fractions, before/after maximum standardized distance using clipped training moments, and per-state diagnostics. New clipped bounds do not reconstruct missing training regimes and may remove signal; no causal attribution from error subgroup differences.
